method: Audit complete existing claims against all compatible raw counterclaims. Refine whole same-library byte cohorts together. Retain one sufficient clause, preferring image import/RTTI metadata, then fewer alternatives and source field order. Preserve source-consensus incoming declarations; omit incomplete contradicted claims. No names, aliases or evaluation labels are invented.
limits: Preferred candidates are suggestions, not independently admitted source identities.
Source coverage differs by architecture: 70 x64 collections, 8 x86 header collections, one original ARM toolset and 10 ARM64 collections. This is not exhaustive coverage of every compiler or ABI.
Qualification uses the previously qualified unchanged Release recognition consumer. No full current-application build, hosted CI pass or competitor-performance superiority is claimed.
Reference-clause selection bounds the global byte index but can withhold candidates when the chosen sufficient site is unavailable. Coverage losses are reported.

performance.scope: Same unchanged Release consumer; three held-out x64 PE probes. Warm matching measures apply plus candidate-name-map construction on identical entry lists; parsing/loading is outside warm timing. Fresh processes include loading/matching with OS page cache and signature disk cache retained.
